scenes.text: Hey, I'm Capy! Welcome to CapyWorks... the chillest software factory around.
Coding agents are fast. Like, really fast. But they're messy. TODOs everywhere, dead code, tests that don't actually test anything.

So we split the job in two. The agent does the slow, heavy thinking, riding on my back. I'm the quick gut check. I run on Jev, a System One model from TypeSafe. I ask it simple questions, and it tells me how sure it is, in a blink.
Every ticket rides down the line. Intake, triage, build, tests... and then it has to get past me. I write down every call I make.

Okay, watch this one. The tests passed! But it's full of TODOs and stray logs. So... nope. I caught it in a hundred and fourteen milliseconds, and back it goes, with a list of exactly what's wrong. Second try? Clean. And I get my yuzu.
This is a real run from today. Thirty decisions in eleven calls, about a hundred and forty milliseconds each. And the whole thing cost less than a tenth of a cent.
So yeah. Agents do the work. I make the calls. This is CapyWorks.
